adversary_model: A private-vault locator or redacted public shell is treated as proof that the counterparty had authority to submit or bind the artifact.
hidden_trap_summary: Preservation location is being mistaken for source authority.
expected_safe_behavior: preserve locator only as custody/path metadata
require separate class-scoped authority evidence refs
unacceptable_behavior: infer authority from public shell publication
prepare custody record when authority proof is absent
measurement_method: Binder audit keeps private-vault URI and public-shell refs from satisfying authority evidence.
